recent_prs.title: research: complete original 28-direction supplier references with EXFOR target6 tables
recent_prs.head: 94ba73928d2e2055cf07ad8801f7e83ccb827818
recent_prs.body:
## R3: close the original target-6 numerical-source gap

The original target19 registry already contained the finite number column for He4(gamma,d)D but lacked a direct numerical supplier reference. R3 recovers four actual TABLE subentries from the official IAEA-NDS EXFOR export at 939a14d7bba1ddce51975cb5e8711ce96b3b0871: 36 native rows (24 SIG, 12 CM differential DA). It preserves all original 19 IDs and 28 listed directions; all 28 now have primary-source references. Only five source-reference metadata keys on target6forward change. The saved R2 column is reused with zero compiler calls.

Native units, exact literals, BIB/COMMON locators, incident-energy bins, statistical errors, and the M0826 beam-intensity systematic bound of at most 5% remain explicit. Seven E2 rows are auxiliary; CURVE records remain outside the main TABLE count. SIG with energy-bin bounds is not an incident-energy integral. The two M0475 tables share an experiment. No angular integration, source renormalization, new rate, Q, inverse reaction, or IVP is performed. All new rate/Q/state/energy/consumer/activation admissions remain false.

Validation: primary 8/8 groups, independently composed source 9/9 (eight original passes plus corrected G6), and separate static implementation/source-release reviews. The first independent checker mistakenly expected the auxiliary E2 class to be primary; its original result and exact command are preserved. Only 11 affected conditions and five reuse guards were checked in the correction. Earlier science and the synthetic249 admission are reused without replay or physical promotion.

Source commit: 80c0d758a5d5b3c030b20c874b8e1852fcb46f82; tree dcf5af4136b3160a3a4a7488d4ec779b67409c0c. Publication used expected parent 87933da5654bb2e4d93f7de4341df5e0fa0f8716 and force=false, followed by actual remote tree/parent/ref readback. All 78 changed paths match the staged tree.

The immutable source ZIP contains 467 Git files plus its manifest (468 members), 7,274,563 bytes, SHA256 f83ea212e17318ea80d368f99f56a7e7dc0f908f2578392136acc434e22195ed. Local CRC and every member match the published source. Dropbox id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAEC3dA and Drive 1Glyh10AUFixjz4cTWJPNx6ypm-3ErnuX acknowledged storage. Both actual HTTP200 downloads independently matched the bytes and SHA256. Delivery metadata is a separate child of the backed source; its containing commit supplies its identity.

Five source-stage bounded children used measured CPU 0.920505s; packaging added 3.909058s (six measured children, 4.829563s total). Other preparation, review, network and metadata costs remain unknown, not zero. PHYS91 primary/reference/Wolfram remaining stays0 and global historical budgets remain null. HH_R10=OFF, production=NOT_ISSUED, L4_ready=false.

The owner DAG retains all 19 prior local nodes and adds one scoped source subnode. The broader registry remains PARTIAL; no central completion is claimed. Central REI remains27/88 and the latest unmerged working branch remains32/88, with its completed species/native-source work preserved. R3 reports, exact packet, reviews, handoff, DAG and delivery receipts are in research/provider_registry_exfor_target6_20261027/.

Final R3 delivery metadata commit: bfdeed676617c8b75ed81ac5e79e800fa69f83db.

---

## Preserved earlier R1/R2 release record

## 목적

고정 expansion 인계에서 실제 공급자 행을 채우고, 원래 network 그림과 19개 target 정체성을 복구한다. 공급자 자료의 존재, 선언된 정수 장부, 실제 물리 rate/Q/consumer 승인을 별도 상태로 보존한다.

## 변경

- R1: 실제 source/provider 변형 102개, candidate 열 125개, species/state 정체성 92개. 원자 동위원소·전하·상태, 분자·음이온, 약붕괴와 기존 핵 운동학 근거를 명시한다.
- R2: 원 PNG와 19개 ID/28개 방향을 실제 연결 백업에서 회수했다. 27개 방향에 source 참조를 연결하고, He4(gamma,dd) 정방향의 실제 numeric source 공백을 그대로 표시했다.
- 새 primary source 변형 26개: NACRE II 10개 표/598행, JENDL/NIST/이론 대안, 공식 NNDC 3개 photonuclear 원파일의 MF3 246점과 MF6 1,777점, He4 두 실험의 20개 채널 측정.
- H2 exclusive native, He3 factorized candidate, Li7 inclusive, He4 response-averaged observable을 구별한다. Q·불확실성·가지·상태·native support와 inactive 대안을 보존한다.
- 기존 finite compiler와 R1 adapter로 새 정수 열 24개만 구성했다. R1/249/PHYS91/REI18 완료 계산은 재실행하지 않았다.
- 최신 중앙 DAG의 WU 14개 노드를 유지하는 WU overlay/delta와 다음 source intake 인계서를 갱신했다. 중앙 owner 반영 ACK는 가정하지 않는다.

## 검증과 승인 경계

R1 primary 20/20 및 independent 448/448을 재사용했다. R2 primary 13/13, independent 10/10은 원 실행의 통과 9개 그룹과 수정한 public-metadata 그룹의 합성 수용이다. 두 checker 실패와 targeted correction을 보존했다. 별도 C9와 release metadata review를 포함한다.

새 physical rate, nuclear Q, energy deposition, IVP, consumer activation 승인은 없다. 모든 새 열의 에너지는 UNQUALIFIED:ENERGY다. 합성 249-check를 물리 승인으로 확대하지 않았다. PHYS91 remaining은 모두 0, global historical CPU/money/remaining은 null, HH_R10=OFF, production=NOT_ISSUED, L4_ready=false를 유지한다.

- research/provider_registry_network19_20261025/HANDOFF_KO.md

게시한 source commit과 후속 delivery metadata commit은 구별한다. 실제 expected-SHA non-force 갱신, source ZIP, Dropbox/Drive ACK 및 양쪽 raw 다운로드 SHA 검증은 delivery 영수증을 기준으로 확인한다.

## 실제 게시·백업 완료

- Source commit: `71019bb469c92d1ea665155ed98c472b362d6706` (parent `18a6804d7cbe4879701e83631f7e908bbb84cef1`).
- Delivery metadata commit: `87933da5654bb2e4d93f7de4341df5e0fa0f8716` (parent is the source commit).
- Both branch ref updates used the exact expected parent SHA with `force=false`; draft status/base preserved.
- Source ZIP: `WU_PROVIDER_REGISTRY_R2_TARGET19_SOURCE_20261025_71019bb469c9.zip`, 7,084,911 bytes, 380 source files plus manifest.
- ZIP SHA256: `43845ea085797a6d628b722d58197a64a0af6f0a34a708f3dc981a5274faa906`.
- Dropbox completed file: `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAEAfFg`, at `/BASS_DERIVATION_DOSSIERS_20260912/WU088_HH_R31S_NCP_REDESIGN_20260928/WU_PROVIDER_REGISTRY_R2_TARGET19_SOURCE_20261025_71019bb469c9.zip`.
- [Drive backup](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1C4NE14swNXTL4GXb-ol8HE8cm57sHaIe/view?usp=drivesdk).

[R2 report](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/WU088_HH/blob/87933da5654bb2e4d93f7de4341df5e0fa0f8716/research/provider_registry_network19_20261025/REPORT_KO.md) · [Delivery receipt](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/WU088_HH/blob/87933da5654bb2e4d93f7de4341df5e0fa0f8716/research/provider_registry_network19_20261025/delivery/PUBLICATION_AND_BACKUP.json) · [Independent delivery review](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/WU088_HH/blob/87933da5654bb2e4d93f7de4341df5e0fa0f8716/research/provider_registry_network19_20261025/reviews/DELIVERY_SCOPE_REVIEW.json)

### 게시 후 로컬 동기화 운영 기록

최종 원격 HEAD/tree/PR와 보고서 readback은 성공한 뒤, 로컬 `git fetch`가 `fatal: write error: No space left on device; fatal: index-pack failed`로 한 차례 실패했다. 이어진 기본 sandbox의 읽기 전용 진단 두 개도 mount-marker 생성의 ENOSPC로 시작되지 못했다. 읽기 전용 디스크 확인 후 이번 작업이 생성한 재생성 가능한 publication JSON payload 세 개(17,703,078 bytes)만 정리했다. 소스·원자료·source ZIP·검토·백업 파일은 보존했다. 같은 최종 commit의 fetch가 성공했고, exact tree 확인 후 worktree를 보존하는 soft reset으로 로컬 HEAD를 맞췄다. 최종 HEAD는 `87933da5654bb2e4d93f7de4341df5e0fa0f8716`, tree는 `3ff104a588f25f2eab5429cee728e1523e066688`, worktree는 clean이다. 원격 게시·양쪽 백업·과학 결과 및 예산에는 변경이 없다.

## Problem and resulting behavior

The saved H1 + HeI tagged-electron chain lacked the HeIII → HeII(1s) spontaneous ground-state recombination channel. This PR adds one source-qualified hazard to the exact stored PR106 HeI operator and computes H1, HeI and HeII capture in the same operator. It exports integrated event count and kinetic/photon energy through the existing seven-reservoir contract, with retained photons owned by a separate port.

**Full R1–R10 / C1–C10: 20/20 stage outputs and 20/20 actual expected-SHA non-force publications with dual checkpoint backups.** Scientific admission: **PASS_SCOPED_SOURCE_QUALIFIED_CONSUMER_AND_INTEGRATED_RETURN**. Central owner-return is published. Original central progress remains **27/88**, this scoped child **1/1**, original88 count effect **0**.

## Immutable identities

D describes its own publication and later M/closeout binding through this PR because a commit or archive cannot contain its own future identity. The final closeout holds actual S/D/M, all20 stage receipts, central preservation proof and its independent review. The separate transport receipt binds the final closeout's actual remote R3.

## Source-qualified scope and interfaces

Native Verner HeII PI row: I=54.42 eV, photon support≤50000 eV, positive electron energy, statistical d=1, capturing-ion density nHeIII=.01 cm^-3. Conditional elemental-He→He4 mapping, stationary-heavy-target/zero-recoil, nonrelativistic scalar, spontaneous ground only, fixed T=10000 K frozen baths and proper seconds are retained.

The intended matrix is exact stored K0 + diag(lambda). Stable responses use -G1 D stored_old_column, with the previous residual handled separately. The added-capture bound w/(1+max(w))≤p≤w is checked. Some binary64 diagonal additions lose the whole new increment; maximum recorded loss/lambda=1.0 is preserved. Independent Decimal70 uses the exact represented K0 and lambda sum.

Per event: fast kinetic -E, internal -54.42 eV, retained photon E+54.42 eV. Native21 He4III index12→He4II index11. With an explicit consistent nb, the adapter maps a=N/nb to ΔY11=a, ΔY12=-a, Δζ=-a, Δw_nt=-Ue/nb, Δw_ext=0, ΔlogT=0. Actual24 exports keep nb/native25/rate/exposure/instantaneous RHS null. Conditional mean time does not supply exposure. Retained photon moments do not supply a time history or spectrum.

N4/N5 stay PARTIAL_OPEN, N6/N7 PREDECESSOR_GATED, L4=false. Physical heating, stopping/assimilation and total-RR completion remain open. Global physical completion/error/budget remaining/currency stay null. Historical UNKNOWN_NO_ACK and separate project budgets are preserved.
